d:
“Pyase Do Badan” is a soulful, romantic track from the 1974 Hindi film Prem Nagar, beautifully sung by Asha Bhosle, composed by S. D. Burman, and penned by lyricist Anand Bakshi. The song starts Aruna Irani, Rajesh Khanna, Hema Malini.
